scope: Proposition 5.6 (Finite parameter discards) of the manuscript “The Boltzmann–Grad limit for stable radial potentials on regular kinetic intervals” (preprints/The-Boltzmann-Grad-limit-for-stable-radial-potentials-on-regular-kinetic-intervals-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 364 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce9fe5976f17b89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 39-40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix L, A, δ > 0, and M0 < ∞. The source-energy cutoff R and fixed numbers U, W < ∞, γ, κ > 0 can be chosen so that, for all sufficiently small ε, the total finite history integral with at least δp marked additions is at most ηΓe−M0p. An addition is marked if it is in a multiple-addition cell, is an endpoint pin, or is an ordinary pin satisfying any of the following conditions: 1. its original parent speed exceeds U, its added absolute velocity exceeds W, or its relative speed is below γ; 2. for a genuine non-force-free isolated continuation, either output increment relative to the incoming parent has magnitude below κ; 39 3. its isolated two-body duration in physical time exceeds ε.96; 4. its contact time is within ε.95 of a cell boundary, or it belongs to a pair of birth times separated by less than 2ε.9. The contribution of S > Rp has the same bound. The constants in this proposition may depend on L; they do not enter the C in (5.14).
